description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding {W}.
Pawn of Ulamog and Sigil of the New Dawn trigger.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Sigil of the New Dawn trigger, causing you to pay {1}{W} to return Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat.
